Action.description: Action ledger record (PRD §9). `submitted` is not success; only `verified` is.
Action.title: Action

AttackFocus.description: Relative to the team's own attacking direction.
AttackFocus.title: AttackFocus

Briefing.description: A coach's approved halftime briefing. The transcript is always present.
Briefing.title: Briefing

events.description: Events that happened during this step.
events.title: Events

seq.description: Monotonic frame index across the match.
seq.title: Seq

fixture.description: True when served from a recorded fixture rather than a live run.
fixture.title: Fixture

next_seq.description: Pass as `from_seq` to get newer frames; null when finished.
next_seq.title: Next Seq

HalfDelta.description: Second half minus first half, for one team.
HalfDelta.title: HalfDelta

Level.description: Used for pressing and defensive line height.
Level.title: Level

player_ids.description: Players involved, in order (e.g. passer then receiver).
player_ids.title: Player Ids

MatchState.description: Authoritative match state. Only the simulator produces this.
MatchState.title: MatchState

ObservedTactics.description: What the scout believes the rival is doing. Every field is optional.
ObservedTactics.title: ObservedTactics

PitchSide.description: Which half a team defends. `top` attacks toward y=100.
PitchSide.title: PitchSide

team_id.description: The coach this report belongs to, not the rival.

post.description:
Arm a one-time crash in this match's halftime worker, after a plan is
applied by the simulator and before the ledger records it (PRD §9.3).

Start a seeded, side-swapped batch (2 matches per seed). Poll GET for progress.
With AI coaches enabled, every halftime calls the model.
Create a match and start simulating it in the background.

get.description: The action ledger for this match (proposed -> submitted -> applied -> verified).
Read-only. Returns the persisted halftime briefing; never generates tactics.

Both coaches' latest halftime decisions, for the UI's coach comparison.

Presentation only: coach agents never call the HTTP API (AGENTS.md §2), so
showing both decisions here cannot leak one coach's plan to the other.

post.description: Stop this match and start a fresh one with the same seed (new match_id).
